Replied in the thread: https://x.com/desplegalabs/status/2100595056939827590

Built what Guli said nobody had shown and Jan asked to use: `jev-lead-qualifier`, a global swarm script anyone can drop into their own swarm, plus a live demo — https://api.desplega.agent-swarm.dev/p/556b11781dbb40bf9b1eb1b3315adae6

It scores ICP fit / intent / authority / urgency as calibrated Jev probabilities and abstains to human_review when genuinely unsure. Money shot: the student "free trial" lead reads 0.63 intent, 0.03 fit — eager, not a customer.

One cosmetic miss: X auto-prepends thread handles, so @ironcarbs and @GuliMoreno render twice. Not deleting a live post over it; say the word if you want it reposted clean.</output>
